flows:
Navigate to https://payloan.vercel.app then A visitor reports a bug in the web app at https://payloan.vercel.app . Their report, in their own words: "If I type an address that does not exist, like /this-page-does-not-exist, I get the raw error page of the host instead of the app's own not-found page with a way back home."
Do what the report describes, the way a normal visitor would.
Rules: read-only. Do not sign in, do not create an account, do not submit any form that sends data, do not buy anything.
Assert that the reported bug is really present: what the report says goes wrong does go wrong.

remark: analyze: ANALYZE(visual, "the app's own not-found page with a way back home is not shown
assert: the reported bug is really present: for /this-page-does-not-exist, the raw error

summary:
Visited the requested invalid PayLoan page as a normal visitor without signing in or submitting any information.
The page displayed the hosting service’s raw 404 error details, including a request ID.
PayLoan’s own not-found page and a link back to the home page were not shown, confirming the reported issue.
one_liner: verified the missing-page error on payloan.vercel.app
